answer: Grade every answer with juries drawn from shards that never overlap, so a sybil cluster hiding in one nebula of fake identities can never grade its own work. Like a harbor that only clears a ship after inspectors from three separate docks agree, a reward lands only when three disjoint juries each sign off. A farm holding a thousand identities still owns just a thin plume of votes inside any single shard, so buying a passing grade means buying majorities in several shards at once and the price multiplies with each shard, while one honest answer passes on its own merit.
